title: user.suspended (v1)
description: An account was suspended. Emitted whenever the account state becomes "suspended": an administrator (PATCH user state or POST /users/{user}/suspend), a bulk user operation (user.bulk job), the lifecycle job (scheduled deactivation or dormant accounts under lifecycle.dormant_action=suspend), or a denied registration review. All of the user's sessions and grants, including offline grants, are revoked in the same transaction (one session.revoked event with reason "account_suspended" per active session).

data.description: Event data. All members are identifiers or state, so the minimal and standard payload forms are identical.

user_id.description: The user whose account state changed.

org_id.description: Never set for this event type by the current server.

x-emitted-by: internal/identity/identity.go: (*Service).SetStateTx (administrator, bulk operations, lifecycle job, registration review)
